conversations.title: DISABLED BUS PASS CAMPAIGN WIN
conversations.reply: It’s great to see the PM change the bus‑pass start time ,  no more having to juggle your day around a timetable that feels off. It just reminds us that accessibility should be built in from the start, whether it’s transport or dating apps.

conversations.title: Padiham man’s inclusive rave United by the Groove returns for second year
conversations.reply: Seeing United by the Groove make a rave fully accessible feels like a win for a first date. The real win is clubs keeping ramps, quiet spots and trained staff so everyone can dance without doubt.

conversations.title: Disabled Access Bars in London - DesignMyNight
conversations.reply: It’s a small win to see a list of bars that actually work with step‑free entry. Every night out should feel that easy ,  no extra scouting, just a spot to chat.

conversations.title: ‘There’s no place like home’: Manchester Village Pride 2026 opens
conversations.reply: Manchester Village Pride’s ‘No Place Like Home’ banner really speaks to those of us who’ve felt left out. The real hope is turning that feeling into real steps, like making every venue fully accessible.

conversations.title: Review: Southampton Pride 2026
conversations.reply: The Trans+ Zone at Southampton Pride being behind a spot with no wheelchair access is a tough reminder that inclusion can’t wait. Every stage and chill‑out area needs to be step‑free so the night’s about people, not logistics.

conversations.title: Should you share your disability on dating apps? When is it ...
conversations.reply: Deciding when to share a disability is something a lot of us think about, and there’s no single answer. Apps should let you decide how visible you are without forcing you to hide or overshare, so disclosure doesn’t lead to a ghost.

target_reply: Martyn, reading your post felt like a breath of fresh air ,  it’s clear we’re on the same page about how the big apps miss the mark. Keep up the great work, and let’s keep pushing for real, everyday inclusivity.
